2607.22987.title: Label-free Industrial Fault Detection via Adversarial Inverse Reinforcement Learning: A System for Run-to-Failure Prognostics
2607.22987.paper_summary: Machinery fault detection (MFD) remains heavily reliant on supervised learning, which struggles with the scarcity of fault labels in real-world settings. While reinforcement learning (RL) offers a framework to model the sequential nature of degradation, current ``RL-based'' MFD methods reduce the problem to a static contextual bandit (CB) formulation: by ignoring state transitions and discarding the temporal discount factor, they collapse to standard supervised classification. We propose an adversarial inverse reinforcement learning (AIRL) framework that treats MFD as an offline IRL problem. Unlike reconstruction-based approaches that rely on static error margins, or CBs that ignore dynamics, our method recovers an intrinsic "health" reward directly from observational state transitions, requiring neither manual reward engineering nor fault labels. On three run-to-failure benchmarks (HUMS2023, IMS, XJTU-SY), AIRL is the only method achieving non-saturated post-detection consistency across all datasets, while CB baselines fail to detect gradual degradation and reconstruction models collapse into always-anomalous states. Code and data: https://github.com/dhirajneupane/AIRL-MFD-DN.
2607.22987.paper_summary_zh: 機械故障檢測 (MFD) 仍然在很大程度上依賴於監督學習，但在現實世界中，故障標籤的稀缺使其面臨挑戰。雖然強化學習 (RL) 提供了一個建模退化序列特性的框架，但當前的「基於 RL」的 MFD 方法將問題簡化為靜態上下文賭徒 (CB) 的形式：通過忽略狀態轉換並捨棄時間折扣因子，它們退化為標準的監督分類。我們提出了一個對抗性逆強化學習 (AIRL) 框架，將 MFD 視為一個離線 IRL 問題。與依賴靜態誤差範圍的重建方法或忽略動態的 CB 不同，我們的方法直接從觀察到的狀態轉換中恢復內在的「健康」獎勵，無需手動獎勵工程或故障標籤。在三個到失效的基準測試 (HUMS2023, IMS, XJTU-SY) 中，AIRL 是唯一一個在所有數據集上實現非飽和後檢測一致性的的方法，而 CB 基準無法檢測逐漸退化，重建模型則崩潰為始終異常的狀態。代碼和數據：https://github.com/dhirajneupane/AIRL-MFD-DN。
